edges.reason: msg.sender is hashed into the PoW digest, binding the reward to the caller.
msg.sender is the source account debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance being set in approve.
msg.sender owns the allowance being set in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Constructor onlyOwner guard authenticates msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on the external ERC20 rescue function.
transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, mutating privileged state.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner after the handover.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable.
Constructor sets the locked guard flag.
Constructor derives maxSupplyForEra from _totalSupply.div(2).
Constructor initialises miningTarget to _MAXIMUM_TARGET.
Constructor calls _startNewMiningEpoch to open the first epoch.
mint credits the reward into balances[msg.sender].
mint increases the tokensMinted counter.
mint records the rewarded miner in lastRewardTo.
mint reads and writes solutionForChallenge to block replay.
mint triggers an epoch rollover after crediting the reward.
mint performs reward arithmetic and an assert against the era cap.
The credited reward amount is the arithmetic sink written into balances.
Epoch rollover increments rewardEra.
Epoch rollover recomputes maxSupplyForEra using divisions by 2**(rewardEra+1).
Epoch rollover increments epochCount.
Epoch rollover refreshes challengeNumber from block.blockhash.
Epoch rollover conditionally invokes the difficulty readjustment.
Difficulty readjustment adds/subtracts from miningTarget.
Difficulty readjustment performs unchecked-bound percentage math.
The computed delta is written back into miningTarget.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
transferFrom moves balances between accounts.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance.
approve writes the allowance into allowed.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call.
The spender contract can reenter approveAndCall while receiveApproval executes.
The external callback can reenter transferFrom before allowance state settles.
The external callback can reenter the payable fallback.
The untrusted token contract can reenter transferAnyERC20Token during transfer.
nonce parameter is mixed into the PoW digest inside mint.
challenge_digest parameter is compared against the recomputed digest.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
to parameter is the recipient credited by transfer.
spender parameter is both allowance beneficiary and callback target.
digest local carries the keccak256 result used for the PoW checks.
reward_amount local is credited into balances.
excess_block_pct_extra local scales the miningTarget adjustment.

normalization_plan.reason: The staged-owner parameter only exists to be written into newOwner by transferOwnership.
The nonce parameter has no meaning outside the PoW digest computation in mint.
The submitted digest parameter is only compared inside mint's verification path.
The amount parameter is fully absorbed by transfer's balance arithmetic.
The recipient parameter is only used to credit balances inside transfer.
The spender parameter doubles as allowance key and external callback target in approveAndCall.
digest is a transient local whose whole lifetime is the mint PoW check.
reward_amount is produced by getMiningReward and immediately credited by mint.
The clamped percentage local only exists to scale the miningTarget retarget math.
